decision_policy.primary_goal: Scion Reliquarian Herald of Thunder autobomber for mapping, with Guardian map and Delve/Fossil testing after defenses are proven.
commit_condition: Reliquarian Fidelitas' Spike Herald/Shock node behavior is confirmed in-game or PoB.
Herald of Thunder reservation and support behavior are confirmed after the 3.29 data update.
Boss shock uptime works without relying on unreliable kill chains.
Storm Secret self-damage is covered by recovery, mitigation, and capped resistances.
fallback_condition: Storm Secret is too expensive or self-damage is unsafe.
Herald reservation or support scaling is worse than expected.
Delve/Fossil feels too fragile after yellow maps.
decision_policy.fallback_action: Stay Scion Reliquarian and swap to the Blight of Contagion fallback package rather than forcing the autobomber.

meta.build_name: Scion Reliquarian Herald of Thunder Autobomber Lvl 90

stats.stat_policy: Theory target for profile scoring only; do not present as PoB-confirmed DPS.

ascendancy_order: Kaom's Roots or equivalent action-speed defense only if it does not break mobility

Main Clear.links: Herald of Thunder - Lightning Penetration Support - Added Lightning Damage Support - Inspiration Support - Increased Critical Strikes Support - Increased Critical Damage Support
Main Clear.reasoning: Primary Reliquarian synergy candidate. Elemental Focus is intentionally excluded until shock uptime is proven from another source.

Boss Shock Starter.links: Storm Brand - Increased Critical Strikes Support - Lightning Penetration Support - Faster Casting Support
Boss Shock Starter.reasoning: Manual boss starter to keep shock and Herald uptime from depending only on map clear kills.

Shock Field.links: Orb of Storms - Increased Critical Strikes Support - Power Charge On Critical Support
Shock Field.reasoning: Stationary supplemental lightning hit source for bosses and tanky rares.

Curse.links: Conductivity - Elemental Weakness - Increased Duration Support
Curse.reasoning: Manual curse package until automation and reservation are verified.

Auras.links: Wrath - Determination - Tempest Shield - Arctic Armour
Auras.reasoning: Final reservation target, not guaranteed all at once before Reliquarian Herald efficiency is confirmed.

Movement.reasoning: Keep movement simple while the autobomber loop is being tested.

Guard.reasoning: Baseline guard until the final defensive shell is known.

Act Leveling.links: Stormblast Mine - Swift Assembly Support - Added Lightning Damage Support
Act Leveling.reasoning: Reliable campaign bridge before Herald of Thunder can carry.

Early Mapping Bridge.links: Storm Brand - Added Lightning Damage Support - Lightning Penetration Support - Inspiration Support
Early Mapping Bridge.reasoning: Use as main damage if Herald loop is not online at map entry.

Fallback Chaos DoT.links: Blight of Contagion - Void Manipulation Support - Efficacy Support - Controlled Destruction Support - Swift Affliction Support
Fallback Chaos DoT.reasoning: Conservative Scion fallback for Delve/Fossil if HoT self-damage or boss uptime fails.

increased Critical Strike Chance for Spells

mods: verify Reliquarian node or actual shield availability

mods: stun immunity and chaos mitigation package if confirmed

pantheon.major: The Brine King until stun/freeze package is solved, then test Lunaris/Solaris
pantheon.minor: Garukhan for mapping or Ralakesh if bleed/DoT pressure appears

deadly: Cannot Regenerate Life, Mana or Energy Shield if recovery is not solved
Less Recovery Rate after Storm Secret is equipped
dangerous: Monsters have increased critical strike chance and multiplier
map_mod_policy.regex_hint: reflect|cannot regen|less recovery|reduced recovery|-max|reduced effect of auras

early_mapping: Prioritize Atlas completion, Kirac, Essence, Harvest, and Betrayal bench unlocks.
Do not force Guardian maps while Herald boss uptime and self-damage are unproven.
Use Storm Brand bridge or Blight fallback if the Herald loop is not stable.
mid_mapping: If T16 is comfortable with rare deaths, test Blight, Expedition, Harvest, and low-invest Delve/Fossil.
If mapping speed is high and deaths are low, test Breach or Legion only after damage feels stable.
guardian_and_delve_gate: Guardian maps require confirmed boss shock uptime and recovery under Storm Secret self-damage.
Delve/Fossil is allowed earlier than Guardian push only at depths where darkness, degens, and rares do not chain-kill the build.

verification_checklist: Does Herald of Thunder remain supported after final 3.29 gem data?
Does Reliquarian Fidelitas' Spike actually improve Herald of Thunder enough to justify Scion?
Can Storm Brand or Orb of Storms start and maintain boss shock reliably?
Can the character sustain Storm Secret self-damage while moving?
Can the build clear a representative T16 without more than rare deaths?
If not, swap to the Blight of Contagion fallback package.
